chunks: 1157 - Al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:

"If you are praying behind an Imam whom you are following, then do not recite behind him, whether you hear his recitation or do not hear it, except that it be a prayer in which the recitation is said aloud and you do not hear, then recite."

key_terms.إِمَامٍ: the prayer leader being followed in congregational salat
key_terms.تَأْتَمُّ: you follow in prayer as a ma'mum behind the Imam
key_terms.تَقْرَأْ: you recite the Qur'an in the prayer
key_terms.صَلَاةً: a prayer, here referring to a specific prayer setting
key_terms.قِرَاءَتَهُ: his recitation, meaning the Imam’s recitation
key_terms.يُجْهَرُ: it is recited aloud or audibly

ai.seo_question: Should a person recite Qur'an behind the Imam in congregational prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about recitation in congregational salat behind an Imam. It instructs the follower not to recite behind the Imam generally, except in an audible prayer when the Imam’s recitation cannot be heard, in which case recitation is allowed.
